thread:
taylor: FYI new hire Omar's H-1B COS is pending and his OPT EAD expires 2026-04-10. Start date currently set to 2026-04-12. Concern: very tight window; need to confirm lawful work eligibility on day 1.

hana: Thanks. If EAD expires 4/10 and COS hasn't been approved by 4/12, Omar would not be authorized to work. We can't onboard until we have a valid work authorization.

taylor: Could we do an unpaid LOA for the 2-week window if adjudication is late? Candidate asked if there's any way to keep benefits active.

payroll: Unpaid LOA is possible. Benefits continuity depends on plan rules; typically benefits end the last day of paid employment and the employee can elect COBRA. We can set a LOA effective 4/11 if necessary.

immigration_bot: Automated update: USCIS receipt SRC-21-432198 filed for Omar; estimated processing 6-8 weeks.

hana: Based on est. 6 weeks, approval likely beyond 4/12. Recommend delaying official start to avoid compliance risk.

omar: I'm concerned about housing. Would a start date of 2026-04-20 be acceptable? That gives some buffer.

taylor: That works from hiring team side. We'll keep it tentative and ask Omar to provide EAD, passport, and I-94 to People Ops.

payroll: Action: payroll to prepare benefits waiver and LOA form; send to omar@redwood.com. Also hold first payroll.

hana: People Ops to coordinate with immigration counsel for any expedite options and to confirm whether receipt alone allows any limited preboarding not constituting work (e.g., background checks).

taylor: Also note for IT: please delay provisioning until we have confirmation of active auth. IT can provide access to the onboarding LMS (read-only) pre-start.

omar: Appreciate it. I'll share documents by EOD and set tentative 4/20 start.

sam: Quick Q: if COS gets approved retroactively to 4/12, how do we handle payroll?

payroll: If approval is retroactive and proves authorized employment from 4/12, payroll can process backpay once we have documentation. But all I-9 and benefits records must reflect actual authorization dates.

taylor: Great. I'll update the offer letter with new tentative start and cc payroll/hr. Thanks everyone.
